import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_managed_care_enrollment_2024.csv')
df_2024 = df[df['Year'] == 2024]

tx_val = int(df_2024[df_2024['State'] == 'Texas']['Medicaid Enrollment in Comprehensive Managed Care'].values[0].replace(',', ''))
fl_val = int(df_2024[df_2024['State'] == 'Florida']['Medicaid Enrollment in Comprehensive Managed Care'].values[0].replace(',', ''))

result = 'yes' if tx_val > fl_val else 'no'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_managed_care_enrollment_2024.csv')
totals = df[df['State'].str.contains('TOTAL', case=False, na=False)].copy()
totals['total_num'] = totals['Total Medicaid Enrollees'].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
best_row = totals.sort_values(by='total_num', ascending=False).iloc[0]
result = str(best_row['Year'])
